body:
feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says brown foam came from the fertilizer trial; our cat hid from the water bowl before traffic was turned around.

Someone said the smell was only from cleaning. I kept the scrap because the same smell had followed us from the previous stop.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: cab note — saturday before sunrise

body: He offered cash to get the road opened while the rest of us waited. The attendant counted the seats in his car and let him go. By morning our line had been listed as empty, though we had never moved.
title: The better car
